adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts the event is built with `destinationCalendar: ... ? [..] : ... ? [..] : null` (so it can be `null`). Immediately after, in the collective team case, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the optional-chained `push` is a no-op and the collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are dropped. This is verifiable from the diff and can break the intended collective behavior when the organizer/eventType has no destination calendar but teammates do.
